title: Webb detects ammonia and unexpected chill on a distant giant planet

beats.caption: Webb detects ammonia and unexpected chill on a distant giant planet
Why is this distant planet colder than scientists predicted?
beats.detail: HATS-6 b is a giant world.
beats.narration: Why is this distant planet so much colder than scientists predicted it would be?

beats.caption: Astronomers used the James Webb Telescope to peer deep into space.
beats.narration: Astronomers used the James Webb Telescope to peer deep into space at a world 500 light-years away.

beats.caption: They found a chemical cocktail in its thick clouds.
beats.narration: They found a specific chemical cocktail in its thick clouds, including water, methane, and ammonia.

beats.caption: The planet is cooler than standard models suggest.
beats.narration: But the data showed something odd. The planet is actually cooler than standard models suggest it should be.

data.left_text: Calculations predicted a specific heat level for this giant planet.
data.right_text: Observations reveal the atmosphere is significantly cooler than expected.

beats.caption: This challenges what we think we know about giant planets.
beats.narration: This challenges what we think we know about how giant planets maintain their heat.

beats.caption: Researchers are now revising their theories on planetary formation.
beats.narration: Researchers are now revising their theories on how these massive worlds form and function.
